info.name: 16 - Financial Reports
info.description: Endpoints to generate revenue and expense reports with date range filtering and chart data.

request.description:
Generates a revenue report for a gym within a date range.

### Route Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `gymId` | `int` | Yes | Target gym ID (must match `CurrentGymId`) |

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `fromDate` | `DateTime` | Yes | Report start date (ISO format). Cannot be in the future. |
| `toDate` | `DateTime` | Yes | Report end date (ISO format). Must be >= `fromDate`. |

### Response (`RevenueReportRDTO`)

| Field | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `totalRevenue` | `decimal` | Total revenue in the period |
| `percentageChangeVsLastPeriod` | `decimal` | % change vs previous equal-length period |
| `chartDataPoints` | `List<FinancialChartPointRDTO>` | `{ date, amount }` for charting |
| `recentTransactions` | `List<RevenueRDTO>` | Latest revenue records |

### Validation Rules
- `fromDate` must not be in the future
- `toDate` must be >= `fromDate`

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner` or `Manager`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.
